name: homologia
description: Scaffold for a future integer comparison between one on-chain computation and one off-chain mirror; substantive operations currently refuse.

interface.shortDescription: Scaffold for a future integer comparison between one on-chain computation and one off-chain mirror; substantive operations currently refuse.
interface.longDescription: Homologia is the planned home for checking whether one pinned Solidity computation and one pinned TypeScript or Python mirror return the same integers over declared vectors. That matters when rounding direction, fixed-point scale, or token-decimal handling is duplicated off-chain. The comparison does not run today. Version 0.1.0 ships the contract, packaging, and a help-only command; it validates no manifest, executes no mirror, compares no vector, and produces no verdict. Every substantive verb refuses. The completed design would preserve each divergence as a specimen and would report agreement only over the supplied vectors, never correctness of either implementation.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $homologia to inspect the current contract-to-mirror comparison scaffold and state which operation must be implemented before this pair can be checked.
